title: Camera spectral sensitivities (rawtoaces-data)
description: 52 digital cameras, their red, green and blue sensitivities as measured for the Academy's RAW to ACES utility: cinema, professional and consumer cameras from ten makers.
source: rawtoaces-data, the data repository of the RAW to ACES Utility (Academy Software Foundation), https://github.com/AcademySoftwareFoundation/rawtoaces-data, commit e9b8503cf8a0641f40e5345d9757bde60c15f423, data/camera/.
changes: The R, G, B columns of each camera file put in this layout and rounded to 6 significant digits.
